name: MultiLayer Image and Text Block
author: NickDigitalProjects

sections.description:
MultiLayer Image and Text Block helps you build professional hero sections, banners, and creative compositions directly inside the WordPress block editor.

Stack unlimited image, text, and button layers, position them freely, and turn a simple banner into a complete call-to-action layout without writing code.

Perfect for:

  • Hero sections with layered images, typography, and CTA buttons
  • Promotional banners and campaign sections
  • Creative photo compositions
  • Landing page headers
  • Portfolio showcases
  • Visual blocks that need both design freedom and clickable actions

Key Features:

  • Unlimited Layers: Add image, text, and button layers in the same container
  • Dedicated Button Layer: Create real call-to-action links, not just styled text
  • Native Link Picker: Choose internal WordPress content or enter an external URL
  • New Tab Control: Open links in the same tab or safely in a new tab
  • Button Style Presets: Start quickly with Primary, Accent, Soft, or Outline styles
  • Fill and Outline Variants: Switch between solid and outlined button designs
  • Button Colors and Hover: Control text, background, and border colors for normal and hover states
  • Border Controls: Set width, style, color, and radius independently
  • Fixed or Fit Content Width: Size buttons manually or let them adapt to their text
  • Typography Controls: Font family, size, weight, spacing, transform, alignment, and line height
  • Modern Sidebar UI: Gutenberg-style ToolsPanel controls with collapsible and resettable options
  • Free Positioning: Position layers with percentage or pixel controls
  • Image Fit Modes: Cover, contain, fill, scale down, or free sizing
  • Layer Management: Rename, reorder, duplicate, select, and remove layers
  • Z-Index and Opacity: Control stacking order and transparency
  • Responsive Layouts: Flexible positioning for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Quick Demo Layouts: Load sample compositions to get started instantly
  • Backward Compatibility: Existing blocks and legacy block names remain supported

Credits

Developed by Nick Digital Projects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/multilayer-image-and-text-block/, or install it from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. In the block editor, search for MultiLayer or find the block in the Design category.
  4. Insert the block and customize the included demo layout, or clear the layers and start from scratch.
  5. Use Layer Tools to add image, text, and button layers.
sections.faq:
Can I add real buttons and links?

Yes. The dedicated Button layer creates a real <a> element when a URL is set. You can link to internal content, external pages, anchors, mailto: addresses, or tel: links.

Can buttons open in a new tab?

Yes. Enable Open in new tab in the Link panel. The frontend output uses target="_blank" with safe rel attributes.

Can I customize button hover colors?

Yes. The Hover colors panel lets you control text, background, and border colors independently from the normal state.

Can I use multiple blocks on the same page?

Yes. You can add as many MultiLayer blocks as needed, each with its own independent layers and settings.

Is it compatible with my theme?

The block works with modern block themes and most classic themes that support the block editor. Button and text styles can inherit or override theme typography.

Is it responsive?

Yes. Layers can be positioned and sized with percentages or pixels, and the frontend script adapts the composition to different screen sizes.

Will existing blocks still work after updating?

Yes. Existing image, text, and button layers remain supported. The plugin also keeps compatibility with the legacy block name used by earlier releases.

How do I get started quickly?

Insert the block to load the demo layout, or use the sample presets in the sidebar. You can then replace images, edit text, and add one or more Button layers.

  • NEW: Auto-loading demo layout with included images (mountain, monster, hot air balloon, fire) for instant visual impact

  • IMPROVEMENT: Added custom multilayer icon for better visual recognition
  • IMPROVEMENT: Added 3 block variations (Hero, Compact, Blank) for instant starter templates
  • FIX: Standardized text domain for proper internationalization
  • FIX: Updated WordPress dependencies (wp-block-editor instead of deprecated wp-editor)

  • NEW: Quick-Add buttons (Image/Text) added to the sidebar for fast layer creation
  • NEW: Quick Tips section included in the sidebar with brief instructions for quick utilization
  • NEW: Added simple “How To” instructions for basic layer customization

  • FIX: Fixed the block alignment issue which was functioning incorrectly
